svg.aria-label: Animated explanation of decoder mask routing in transformers
svg.title: Decoder Mask Routing — Animated
svg.desc: Shows why self-attention uses causal mask and cross-attention uses padding mask

g.text: Core: "Where are my Keys and Values coming from?"
K,V from decoder → causal mask · K,V from encoder → padding mask
Sentences have different lengths. Shorter ones get
filled with <PAD> — fake tokens that must not
Same mask for every query position
At inference, decoder generates one token at a time.
Position i must NOT see positions > i — those
Q = decoder · K = decoder · V = decoder
"Which decoder tokens matter to each other?"
Future tokens don't exist at inference!
Q = decoder · K = encoder · V = encoder
"What source tokens matter to each decoder position?"
Source is fully known — no causal needed
→ causal constraint GONE — decoder peeks at future
→ padding constraint GONE — <PAD> tokens leak in
→ causal: position i cannot see > i ✓
Training looks fine (cheating), but inference collapses — model relied on tokens that don't exist yet.
<PAD> encoder outputs get real attention weights — decoder injects noise from meaningless padding.
